user.title: Set up HA Insights
user.description: HA Insights observes your home state to suggest automations. Pick how (or whether) the LLM enrichment surface works. You can change this later in Configure.

data_description.llm_mode: Off: pattern detection only, no LLM calls. Local: route Explain / Refine / Hypothesize to a local LLM (Ollama, Wyoming) — data stays on your network. Cloud: pseudonymized data is sent to your configured cloud LLM (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google). Real names never leave; sensitive attributes are stripped.

cloud_consent.title: Cloud LLM — confirm data flow
cloud_consent.description:
Cloud LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) live outside your home network. With pseudonymization on by default, real entity names and area names never leave; numeric values are bucketed; sensitive attributes (GPS, MAC, tokens, passwords) are always stripped. Every outbound call is recorded in the privacy log sensor.

Local LLM is recommended if available. Continue with cloud anyway?

init.title: HA Insights settings
init.description: Pick a path: the Quick setup wizard walks you through the handful of decisions that matter; Per-user notification overrides tunes mobile pushes per household member; Advanced settings exposes every option on one screen.

data.path: What would you like to do?

data_description.path: Quick setup walks the typical decisions in 4 screens. Advanced shows every option at once. Per-user overrides tunes mobile pushes for individual household members.

wizard_intro.title: Quick setup

data_description.continue: Tap Submit to start the wizard.

wizard_preset.title: How chatty should notifications be?
wizard_preset.description:
Each preset bundles a confidence floor, daily cap, and quiet hours. You can fine-tune later in Advanced settings.

• Quiet — only critical insights, never during sleep
• Balanced — meaningful insights during waking hours (recommended)
• Chatty — low bar for power users who like seeing every pattern
• Adaptive — starts Balanced and auto-tunes against your dismiss/apply behaviour
• Manual — skip the preset and configure each knob directly in Advanced

data_description.notify_preset: The preset becomes the default — per-user overrides can still customise it for specific household members.

wizard_mobile.description:
Optional — leave empty for panel-only notifications.

Example: {example}

data_description.notify_mobile_targets: Multi-select against the notify.mobile_app_* services HA discovered from your installed HA Companion apps. You can also paste service names HA hasn't surfaced yet.

wizard_experimental.title: Enable experimental detectors?
wizard_experimental.description: Off by default. Experimental detectors run additional pattern detection (phone-charge reminders, weather correlations) that have a wider noise/signal trade-off than the stable set. Recommended for users who want to help refine new detectors and don't mind the occasional false positive.

data_description.allow_experimental_detectors: You can toggle this off any time without losing existing insights.

wizard_done.title: Setup complete
wizard_done.description: Your settings are saved. Open the HA Insights sidebar panel to see your home-state observations and any insights detected so far. Re-run this wizard any time from Settings → Devices & Services → HA Insights → Configure.

data_description.finish: Tap Submit to save and return.

user_overrides_pick.title: Per-user notification overrides — pick a user
user_overrides_pick.description: Choose which household member's notification preferences you want to override. Each user inherits the global preset unless an override exists.

data_description.target_user_id: Each row shows the user's name, their phone count, and whether an override is already in place.

user_overrides_edit.title: Override for {user_name}
user_overrides_edit.description: Customise notifications for this user. Current state: {has_override} override exists. Tick "Clear override" to reset back to the global preset.

data_description.preset: Choose a preset for this user, or Custom to use the values below.
data_description.confidence_floor: Minimum insight confidence required to push to this user's phone.
data_description.daily_cap: Maximum mobile pushes per local day for this user. 0 = unlimited.
data_description.quiet_hours_start: Hour to start deferring non-urgent pushes to the next digest.
data_description.quiet_hours_end: Hour to resume pushing — defines the end of the sleep window.
data_description.min_attribution_confidence: Minimum target_user_id confidence required to push to this user. Below this we send to persistent_notification only.
data_description.clear_override: When ticked, removes this user's override entirely on save. Other form fields are ignored.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Every option in one form. Use the Quick setup wizard instead if you'd rather walk through the handful of decisions that matter most.

data.scan_areas: Limit scans to these areas (empty = all areas)
data.scan_interval_hours: Auto-scan every N hours (0 = manual only)

data_description.llm_mode: Off: pattern detection only. Local: data stays on your network. Cloud: pseudonymized data sent off-network.
data_description.lookback_days: How many days of HA recorder history to backfill at startup so detectors have data immediately. 0 disables backfill. Range 0-30; default 14 covers the schedule and seasonality detectors.
data_description.notify_on_insight: Fire a persistent_notification the moment a new insight lands above the confidence threshold below.
data_description.notify_threshold: Minimum confidence (0.0-1.0) for an insight to trigger an immediate notification. Default 0.8 means only very confident proposals notify; lower it to be alerted on more.
data_description.digest_enabled: Send one persistent_notification per day with a rollup of new and still-open insights. Auto-suppressed when there is nothing to report.
data_description.digest_hour: Hour of day (0-23, local time) to fire the daily digest. Default 9 = 9 AM.
data_description.preferred_agent_id: Which conversation agent to try first for Explain, Refine, and Hypothesize. Failover walks the other installed agents if it fails. Leave blank to auto-pick (Assist default first, then registry order). With multiple HA Insights entries, the first non-empty preference wins integration-wide.
data_description.refine_cost_threshold_usd: When a Refine call's estimated USD cost exceeds this, the card shows a confirm dialog before sending. 0 = always confirm, 10 = effectively never. Local agents always cost $0 and never trigger the confirm. With multiple HA Insights entries, the lowest threshold wins so a cautious entry isn't bypassed by a permissive one.
data_description.allow_user_detectors: Off by default. When on, *.py files placed under your HA config dir at ha_insights_detectors/ load as community detectors. Each file is AST-scanned and rejected if it imports network/filesystem/subprocess modules or uses eval/exec/__import__, but the sandbox is best-effort — only enable for files you trust. See the writing-a-detector docs.
data_description.enabled_detectors: Pick which detectors run on every scan. Default = all. Disabling a detector skips its work entirely; enabling one explicitly overrides the auto-skip safety net (e.g. to force lagged_correlation on a large-event-buffer install).
data_description.scan_areas: Multi-pick HA areas. Empty = all areas (default). When set, detectors only see events from entities in the selected areas. Useful for limiting scope on large installs (e.g. living areas only).
data_description.scan_interval_hours: 0 = manual only (default; click Run Scan Now in the panel). 1+ = run all enabled detectors every N hours. The timer is registered after HA finishes startup so it never fires during boot.
data_description.audit_rollup_window_days: How many days of HA recorder history to roll up into seasonal / day-of-week buckets for the automation-audit detector. Range 7-180. Default 90 detects quarter-scale patterns. Going beyond your recorder's actual retention is wasted work. Upper bound stays 180 until v1.2 chunked backfill ships — going higher today can spike memory on big installs.
data_description.audit_analysis_depth: Controls how much guidance the audit LLM prompt includes. 'concise' (~150 tokens) is right for most cases. 'indepth' (~600 tokens) adds reasoning principles for stricter refinements — costs more, slower. Stage-two refinements always force concise.
data_description.audit_monthly_budget_usd: Caps cloud-LLM spend for the audit subsystem each month. Local agents (Ollama/Wyoming) bypass entirely. 0 = always allow. Resets on the 1st of each month.
data_description.audit_auto_rollup_enabled: Default OFF. When ON, runs one chunked incremental rollup batch every 6 hours plus a delayed kick 5 minutes after HA boots, keeping seasonal/day-of-week buckets fresh without manual clicks. Bounded by per-chunk timeout (15s), per-entity wall clock (60s), per-batch budget (120s), batch size (25 entities), row cap (5000/chunk), and a single-flight lock so it can't pile up. Uses the recorder's own executor pool, so it cooperates cleanly with HA's history/statistics features instead of fighting for connections. Leave OFF if you prefer zero background recorder I/O — manual ‘📅 Run audit rollup’ still works.
data_description.notify_mobile_targets: Multi-select against the notify.mobile_app_* services HA discovered from your installed HA Companion apps. Empty = panel-only notifications. You can also paste service names HA hasn't surfaced yet.
data_description.notify_preset: Picks the chattiness profile. Basic — Balanced is recommended. Adaptive auto-learns your dismiss/apply tolerance over time. Advanced honors the custom knobs below.
data_description.notify_mobile_threshold: Honored only when the preset is Advanced. Minimum insight confidence for mobile pushes. Default 0.9 keeps the bar high — a buzzing phone is a much more expensive interruption than a panel toast.
data_description.notify_mobile_daily_cap: Honored only when the preset is Advanced. Maximum mobile pushes per local day before overflow falls through to the daily digest. 0 = unlimited.
data_description.notify_quiet_hours_start: Honored only when the preset is Advanced. Hour to start deferring non-urgent pushes to the next digest. Default 22 = 10 PM.
data_description.notify_quiet_hours_end: Honored only when the preset is Advanced. Hour to resume pushing — defines the end of the sleep window. Default 7 = 7 AM.
data_description.notify_min_attribution_confidence: Honored only when the preset is Advanced. Below this, target-specific mobile pushes are downgraded to persistent_notification (avoids buzzing the wrong person on a weak manual-map match).
data_description.allow_experimental_detectors: Off by default. Experimental detectors (PhoneChargeReminder, WeatherCorrelation) have a wider noise/signal trade-off than the stable set. Enable to help refine new detectors; insights from them are tagged with a 🧪 badge.
data_description.goal_bedtime_by: Target time you want to start charging your phone by (i.e. bedtime). HH:MM 24-hour. The Goal Tracker detector reports adherence — 'on time on 4 of last 7 nights'. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.goal_wake_up_by: Target time you want to be up by — measured as 'phone stops charging'. HH:MM 24-hour. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.goal_leave_home_by: Target time you want to leave home — measured from your device_tracker leaving the Home zone. HH:MM 24-hour. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.goal_get_to_work_by: Target time you want to arrive at a non-home zone (work). HH:MM 24-hour. Needs the HA Companion app's location tracking. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.goal_home_by: Target time you want to be back home. HH:MM 24-hour. Leave blank to disable.
